pr.title: feat(dcp): TP-105 surface_guard taxonomy alignment + fallback equality + dcp-accept deny
pr.body:
## Summary
- Rebases `.claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py` onto `load_taxonomy()` from TP-103: when `USE_TAXONOMY_LOADER=True`, surface guard derives denied paths from the taxonomy instance rather than a separate hardcoded list.
- Regenerates `_FALLBACK_FORBIDDEN` from hard_block lanes — same regeneration logic as FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES in TP-103, keeping the two in sync.
- Upgrades sync test from subset-check to equality on the hard_block subset (every hard_block-lane path detector is present in the fallback, and the fallback contains no extra entries not in the taxonomy).
- Adds PreToolUse deny matcher for `dcp accept` invocations from model sessions (string-matchable, defense-in-depth — bypassable by obfuscation; TTY-refusal in TP-110 is the real barrier; documented explicitly).
- Risk note A14: multi-worktree hook reliability degraded until DX-overhaul P6 MCP cutover.

## STOP condition
If `.claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py` is absent from HEAD, halt and record NOT_RUN in PROOF.json. Re-scope to restore or introduce the active PreToolUse guard path before taxonomy coupling.

## Depends on
DMX-DCP-TOOLING-103 (load_taxonomy() required), active `.claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py` present on HEAD.

## Scope
.claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py + tests/test_dcp_surface_guard.py. No CI workflow edits.

## NOT_RUN
Full hook integration test in live session, P6 worktree reliability.
